content:
sarah_acme: Hey team — we just finished the signup flow for AcmeAnalytics and the console shows the org and project (org: acme-898, project: acme-898-prod) but there is no API key in the project. trying to call /v1/generate returns 401: "missing API key".

maria_support: hey @sarah_acme — sorry about that. can you paste the org id and the email used to sign up? also was this via SSO or the self-serve flow?

sarah_acme: org id acme-898, sign-up email sarah@acmeanalytics.com. self-serve (email + invite link). we clicked through the console create-project flow. i can share a screenshot if helpful.

maria_support: thanks. quick checks: 1) do you see a project-level API key in Console -> Projects -> acme-898-prod -> Credentials? 2) do you see any errors in the browser console when creating the project?

sarah_acme: no keys listed under Credentials. browser console had a 202 on the create request then nothing. the UI showed a spinner for ~30s and then returned to the project page with no key.

maria_support: that's consistent with a provisioning claim not being applied. pinging onboarding infra: @jake_onboarding and @lee_infra can you check provisioning logs for acme-898 around 2043216789?

onboarding_bot: [provisioning] claim_received org=acme-898 project=acme-898-prod flow=self-serve request_id=req_7e4b2f
onboarding_bot: [provisioning] attempting service-role-assignment org=acme-898 project=acme-898-prod
onboarding_bot: [error] role_bind_failure: missing role definition "inference.api_user" for service_account onboarding-sa-7e4b

jake_onboarding: thanks for the tag. looks like the onboarding service attempted to bind the service role but the role definition wasn't present in the org ruleset. that explains the missing key: we don't create project API keys until the service account has the inference.api_user role.

lee_infra: confirming from infra side — we rolled a small config change last night that accidentally gated the dynamic role import for new orgs behind a feature flag. new orgs created during the flag window didn't receive the role template.

maria_support: ok. short-term fix for Acme: we can manually create the API key and bind it to the project. long-term we need to backfill role templates and replay provisioning for affected orgs. @lee_infra can you run the backfill?

lee_infra: yep. plan: 1) run role-template-import for org acme-898 2) attach inference.api_user to onboarding-sa-7e4b 3) trigger provisioning replay (provisioning.replay req_7e4b2f) 4) verify key appears in project credentials. I'll run a dry-run then full.

sarah_acme: appreciate it. is there any time estimate? customer is blocked from testing models.

lee_infra: dry-run shows expected bindings would succeed. full run in ~10-15m. i'll post when done.

jake_onboarding: note for ops: the replay command is `POST /internal/onboard/replay` with body `{ "request_id": "req_7e4b2f" }` and service will idempotently create the project key if missing. also watch for race with console key generator — avoid double-create.

maria_support: also FYI for support playbook: when a project key is missing but project exists, check onboarding_bot logs for "role_bind_failure" and check feature flag state `dynamic_role_import_enabled`. added to our KB.

lee_infra: full run started. executing role-template-import for org acme-898...

onboarding_bot: [provisioning] role_template_imported org=acme-898 success
onboarding_bot: [provisioning] binding role=inference.api_user to service_account=onboarding-sa-7e4b
onboarding_bot: [provisioning] replay triggered request_id=req_7e4b2f
onboarding_bot: [provisioning] created_project_api_key project=acme-898-prod key_id=key_mQ7a9
onboarding_bot: [audit] api_key_created_by=onboarding-service request_id=req_7e4b2f

lee_infra: done. the key should now show in Console -> Projects -> acme-898-prod -> Credentials. @sarah_acme can you check?

sarah_acme: i can see the key now, thanks! tried a quick curl and got 200 for /v1/generate.

sarah_acme: example curl i ran: `curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"test"}'` -> 200 OK, tokens returned.

maria_support: great. leaving next steps here for tracking: - infra to run backfill for orgs created between 2043000000 and 2043220000 (lee) - engineering to add an alert on role template import failures (jake) - support KB updated (maria)

jake_onboarding: i'll add an instrumentation metric for role_bind_failure and a retry queue for failed binds. estimate 2d to ship a quick alert + retry.

lee_infra: infra backfill queued and running in background. i will post a report with count and org ids.

maria_support: reassigning ticket to support-ops for follow-up. @sarah_acme — feel free to re-open if anything else pops up. sorry again for the churn and thanks for your patience. :pray:

sarah_acme: thank you all! :tada:

maria_support: closing internal thread after postmortem created. logging incident under INC-20432-onboard-role-miss for compliance.

onboarding_bot: [postmortem] incident logged id=INC-20432-onboard-role-miss severity=low owner=infra

lee_infra: final note: we've toggled the feature flag back on and added a healthcheck to the role-import path so this should not recur.

maria_support: resolved — marking thread closed.
